evidenceClass: Actual installed-function SQL-role audit replay in local PGlite using only synthetic fixtures; not hosted execution, signed JWTs, native OCR or independent-session contention.
correction: Current v6 is leased while it is the sole queued fixture. Legacy fixtures are added afterward and actual returned legacy jobs are finished; no enqueue timestamp ordering assumption or timestamp/quota edits.
